simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְגוֹרַה (H4034) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: מְגוֹרַה (mᵉgôwrah) means affright First listed occurrence: Prov 10 24.

definitions.full: H4034. megorah [ מְגוֺרָה ] noun feminine fear, terror — construct מְגוֺרַת Prov 10:24 ; plural suffix מְגוּרוֺתַי Psa 34:5 , מְגוּרֹתָם Isa 66:4 (on these forms with וּ compare Ges § 27 . 3. R.1, & 85. 48); — terror (= thing dreaded) Psa 34:5 ; Prov 10:24 ; Isa 66:4 .
